name: angular-frontend-plugin
description: Build, fix, refactor, and review Angular frontend applications with guidance matched to the installed Angular, TypeScript, and RxJS versions.

interface.shortDescription: Build Angular apps with version-aware engineering guidance.
interface.longDescription: Implement and review Angular components, templates, dependency injection, Signals and RxJS state, HTTP flows, forms, routing, accessibility, performance, and tests using the target project's installed versions and conventions.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $angular-frontend to inspect this Angular project and implement the requested change using its installed version and conventions, then verify the affected behavior.
